description: Consistency with continuity for the MONOTONE PPM scheme on the latlon3d grid at 12x7x9 -- the free-stream-preservation gate for the PRODUCTION reconstruction, as opposed to its donor-cell sibling latlon3d_transport_cwc_3d. Six rules fire at once: three bare-D face-flux-divergence rules closing continuity (lon periodic, lat polar, lev no-flux) and three compound monotone PPM flux-form advection rules carrying the tracer. At q == 1 the CW84 reconstruction collapses to the constant 1 (every slope is exactly 0.0), the face flux becomes F = M bitwise, and q stays exactly 1. MEASURED: dev = 0.0 exactly at t=0 and t=0.1. The assertion reference is the constant zero, so non-vacuity is established separately by problems/_falsifier_ppm3d.esm (ic(mq) x 1.000001), which drives dev to 1.08e-6 and correctly fails -- re-run it if this problem changes. Only the t=0.1 assertion discriminates: dev is a state with dev(0)=0 by construction. Costs ~370 s / ~3.5 GB, dominated by the monotone PPM build (esm-spec 9.7.3 inlining), not the solve. See README.md. PYTHON (added 2026-07-23): the case also runs on the python binding (LSODA, rtol 1e-10 / atol 1e-12) -- dev = 0.0 exactly at t=0 and t=0.1; measured cost through scripts/runners/run-python.py is 166 s / 0.99 GB, i.e. the python build of the monotone PPM stack is ~2x faster and ~3.5x leaner than julia's.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
